item.title: “BCCI has not received any communication”- Devajit Saikia on reports of ICC searching new venues for Bangladesh’s T20 WC 2026 matches
item.description: BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia stated that the Board of Control for Cricket in India has not received an update from the International Cricket Council regarding a reported change in venue for Bangladesh's T20 World Cup matches and that the matter is being discussed between the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) and the ICC. item.title: ECB mulling stricter controls, imposing curfew on England players after Ashes booze controversy- Report
item.description: The England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) is considering imposing a stringent curfew on players following worries about binge drinking and off-field conduct during England's catastrophic Ashes tour to Australia. The Ashes, which England lost 1-4, prompted a thorough internal investigation, with team culture now under intense examination. Reports from Australia depicted an ominous picture. item.title: WATCH: Pakistan’s Mohammad Rizwan gets retired out for sluggish knock in Big Bash League
item.description: Pakistan wicketkeeper-batter Mohammad Rizwan achieved an undesirable feat in Australia’s Big Bash League (BBL) on Monday (January 12), becoming the first overseas player to be retired out. Playing for Melbourne Renegades against Sydney Thunder, Rizwan struggled to get quick runs while batting at No. 4. item.title: “Will not make compromise”: Bangladesh government's sports advisor reiterates stand of not wanting to play T20 WC in India
item.description: Asif Nazrul, the Bangladesh government's sports advisor, on Monday (January 12) made it clear they are open to playing the T20 World Cup 2026 matches at any venue other than India. Nazrul’s comment comes after it was reported that Chennai and Thiruvananthapuram are being considered as potential venues for Bangladesh's World Cup fixtures. item.title: WATCH- ‘Its existence is unnecessary’- Saeed Ajmal says ICC is ‘helpless’ as it is dominated by Indians
item.description: Former Pakistan off-spinner Saeed Ajmal has claimed that the International Cricket Council (ICC) will become "unnecessary" if it does not address the Indian Cricket Board's (BCCI) existing "dominance" in its operations. item.title: Australia captain Alyssa Healy announces shock retirement from cricket; India series to be her last
item.description: Widely regarded among the best players ever in women's cricket, Australia’s Alyssa Healy will call time on her 15-year international career in March after the multi-format home series against India. Healy, 35, has amassed more than 7,000 runs across all three international formats and completed 275 dismissals since making her debut for Australia in 2010.
